name: ComPatch LLWA + E&F
short_description: E&F's stock/liquidity registration is a hand-written per-building whitelist that predates LLWA and mentions none of LLWA's six privately-owned buildings, so LLWA's whole transport network sits outside E&F's economy: no liquidity, no stock, no private ownership. This wires all six into E&F's railroad-stock mechanics, the same way E&F+Morgenroete already does for Morgenroete's 62 custom buildings. Load after both.
